#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;

const int MAXN=250015;
LL inv[MAXN], p[MAXN];

void initialize(int MAXNUM, LL mod) {
    inv[0]=inv[1]=1;
    p[0]=p[1]=1;
    for(int i=2; i<=MAXNUM; i++) {
        inv[i]=(mod - mod/i)*inv[mod%i]%mod;
        p[i]=p[i-1]*i%mod;
    }
    for(int i=2; i<=MAXNUM; i++) inv[i]=inv[i-1]*inv[i]%mod;
}

LL mod_pow(LL base, LL exp, LL mod) {
    LL result=1;
    while(exp>0) {
        if(exp&1) result=result*base%mod;
        base=base*base%mod;
        exp>>=1;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    LL n, k, mod;
    cin>>n>>k>>mod;
    initialize(n+5, mod);
    if(n%2==1) {
        cout<<mod_pow(k, n, mod)<<endl;
    } else {
        vector<int> megumi;
        for(int i=2; i<=n; i+=2) {
            if((i&n)==i) megumi.push_back(i);
        }
        vector< vector<LL> > dp(20, vector<LL>(n+1,0));
        LL answer=0;
        dp[0][n]=1;
        int limit=min(17, (int)k);
        for(int i=1; i<=limit; i++) {
            LL tmpans=0;
            for(auto &val: megumi) {
                if(dp[i-1][val]==0) continue;
                int Megumi=val&(val-1);
                int step=Megumi^val;
                for(int k_=step; k_<=Megumi; k_+=step) {
                    if((k_ & Megumi)==k_) {
                        LL val_dp=dp[i-1][val]*p[val]%mod*inv[k_]%mod*inv[val - k_]%mod;
                        dp[i][k_]=(dp[i][k_]+val_dp)%mod;
                    }
                }
                tmpans=(tmpans+dp[i-1][val])%mod;
            }
            answer+=tmpans*inv[k - i]%mod;
        }
        answer=answer*p[k]%mod;
        LL final_ans=mod_pow(k, n, mod)-answer;
        final_ans=(final_ans%mod+mod)%mod;
        cout<<final_ans<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
